{"path": "analyze.py", "content": "import bpy, numpy as np, os

def load(p):
    img = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.abspath(p))
    w, h = img.size
    a = np.array(img.pixels[:], dtype=np.float32).reshape(h, w, 4)
    bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    # flip: bpy pixels start at bottom-left
    return a[::-1].copy(), w, h   # row 0 = top

def q(a, bits=4):
    r = (a[..., 0]*255).astype(np.uint8)
    g = (a[..., 1]*255).astype(np.uint8)
    b = (a[..., 2]*255).astype(np.uint8)
    return np.stack([r>>bits, g>>bits, b>>bits], -1)

def stats(p):
    a, w, h = load(p)
    print("=== %s  %dx%d" % (p, w, h))
    K = q(a, 4)
    keys = (K[...,0].astype(np.int32)<<8) | (K[...,1].astype(np.int32)<<4) | K[...,2].astype(np.int32)
    vals, cnts = np.unique(keys, return_counts=True)
    order = np.argsort(-cnts)
    for i in order[:14]:
        v = vals[i]; c = cnts[i]
        r_ = (v>>8)&15; g_ = (v>>4)&15; b_ = v&15
        rgb = (r_*16, g_*16, b_*16)
        m = keys == v
        ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
        print("  rgb~%-16s cnt=%7d  bbox x %d..%d  y %d..%d" % (rgb, c, xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max()))
    return a, w, h

for p in ["inputs/view_front.png", "inputs/view_back.png", "inputs/view_left.png", "inputs/view_right.png", "inputs/view_top.png"]:
    stats(p)
"}

{"path": "tool.py", "content": "import bpy, numpy as np, os, sys

def load(p):
    img = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.abspath(p))
    w, h = img.size
    a = np.array(img.pixels[:], dtype=np.float32).reshape(h, w, 4)
    bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    return (a[::-1, :, :3]*255).round().astype(np.int16)

def cls(a):
    r, g, b = a[...,0].astype(int), a[...,1].astype(int), a[...,2].astype(int)
    mx = np.maximum(np.maximum(r,g),b); mn = np.minimum(np.minimum(r,g),b)
    out = np.zeros(r.shape, dtype=np.int8)  # 0 bg
    out[(mx-mn>25)] = 1                      # chromatic
    gray = (mx-mn<=25)
    out[gray & (mn>=243)] = 2                # white-ish (incl bg)
    out[gray & (mn>=150) & (mn<243)] = 3     # light grey
    out[gray & (mn>=95) & (mn<150)] = 4      # mid grey
    out[gray & (mn>=45) & (mn<95)] = 5       # dark grey
    out[gray & (mn<45)] = 6                  # near black
    return out

NAMES = {0:'bg',1:'col',2:'wht',3:'lgry',4:'mgry',5:'dkry',6:'blk'}

def runs(seq):
    res = []
    s = seq[0]; st = 0
    for i in range(1, len(seq)):
        if seq[i] != s:
            res.append((NAMES[s], st, i-1))
            s = seq[i]; st = i
    res.append((NAMES[s], st, len(seq)-1))
    return [x for x in res if x[2]-x[1] >= 1]

def prof(img, axis, idx, minlen=2):
    a = load(img)
    line = a[idx, :] if axis == 'row' else a[:, idx]
    c = cls(np.stack([line, line, line], -1))
    rs = [x for x in runs(c) if x[2]-x[1] >= minlen-1]
    print("%s %s=%d:" % (img, axis, idx))
    print("   " + "  ".join("%s[%d-%d]" % (n, s, e) for n, s, e in rs))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pass
"}

{"content": "import bpy, numpy as np, os

def load(p):
    img = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.abspath(p))
    w, h = img.size
    a = np.array(img.pixels[:], dtype=np.float32).reshape(h, w, 4)
    bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    return (a[::-1, :, :3]*255).round().astype(np.int16)

NAMES = {0:'bg',1:'blue',2:'org',3:'red',4:'grn',5:'ylw',6:'wht',7:'lgry',8:'mgry',9:'dkry',10:'blk'}

def cls(a):
    r, g, b = a[...,0].astype(int), a[...,1].astype(int), a[...,2].astype(int)
    mx = np.maximum(np.maximum(r,g),b); mn = np.minimum(np.minimum(r,g),b)
    out = np.zeros(r.shape, dtype=np.int8)
    chrom = (mx-mn) > 30
    out[chrom & (b > r+10)] = 1
    out[chrom & (r>180) & (g>140) & (b<120)] = 5          # yellow
    out[chrom & (r>150) & (g>60) & (g<=140) & (b<110)] = 2  # orange
    out[chrom & (r>110) & (g<=60) & (b<=80)] = 3          # red
    out[chrom & (g>=r) & (g>b) & (g>90)] = 4              # green
    gray = ~chrom
    out[gray & (mn>=243)] = 6
    out[gray & (mn>=150) & (mn<243)] = 7
    out[gray & (mn>=95) & (mn<150)] = 8
    out[gray & (mn>=45) & (mn<95)] = 9
    out[gray & (mn<45)] = 10
    return out

def rle(seq):
    res = []; s = seq[0]; st = 0
    for i in range(1, len(seq)+1):
        if i == len(seq) or seq[i] != s:
            res.append([NAMES[s], st, i-1]); s = seq[i] if i < len(seq) else None; st = i
    return res

def prof(img, axis, idx, minlen=2, lo=0, hi=99999):
    a = load(img)
    line = a[idx, :] if axis == 'row' else a[:, idx]
    c = cls(np.stack([line, line, line], -1))
    rs = [x for x in rle(c) if (x[2]-x[1] >= minlen-1) and x[2] >= lo and x[1] <= hi]
    print("%s %s=%d:" % (img.split('/')[-1], axis, idx))
    print("   " + "  ".join("%s[%d-%d]" % tuple(x) for x in rs))

def bbox(img, names):
    a = load(img); c = cls(a)
    for n in names:
        k = [kk for kk, v in NAMES.items() if v == n][0]
        m = (c == k)
        if not m.any():
            print("  %s: none" % n); continue
        ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
        print("  %-5s n=%6d  x %d..%d   y %d..%d" % (n, m.sum(), xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max()))
